args.query: NumPy 2.0 removed np.float_, np.NaN and np.Inf: fix AttributeError after upgrading

results.title: NumPy + SciPy curve_fit and bounded minimize, tested with seeded noise
results.summary: Fit a noisy exponential with scipy.optimize.curve_fit and bounded L-BFGS-B minimization, then assert recovered parameters with NumPy testing helpers and check residuals with scipy.stats.

results.title: SQLAlchemy 2.0 hybrid properties, column_property and before_flush audit events
results.summary: Map hybrid_property and column_property on SQLAlchemy 2.0 models, stamp audit timestamps with a before_flush listener, and test everything offline on in-memory SQLite.

results.title: tenacity Retrying with stop_after_attempt and wait_exponential
results.summary: Build a tenacity Retrying policy that stops after N attempts, backs off exponentially and only retries transient exception types, then prove the behavior offline under pytest.

results.title: ftfy mojibake repair and curly-quote normalization
results.summary: Repair Latin-1 mojibake with ftfy, undo double-encoding, straighten curly quotes to ASCII and control HTML unescaping, all tested offline under pytest.

results.title: httpx + tenacity async retries honoring Retry-After, tested with respx
results.summary: Wrap async httpx calls in tenacity AsyncRetrying that retries 429 and 5xx, honors Retry-After, and patches the wait to zero in tests with respx mocks.

results.title: pandas to_sql and read_sql with a SQLAlchemy 2 engine on sqlite, with dtype handling
results.summary: Write and read DataFrames through a SQLAlchemy 2 engine, control column types with dtype, and handle datetimes and nullable ints, tested offline on in-memory sqlite.

results.title: scikit-learn Pipeline with ColumnTransformer on pandas, GridSearchCV and joblib
results.summary: A scikit-learn Pipeline that scales numeric columns and one-hot encodes categories inside a ColumnTransformer on a pandas DataFrame, tuned with GridSearchCV, then saved and reloaded with joblib. Tested offline on small in-memory data.

results.title: Pydantic v2 Annotated validators (Before and After)
results.summary: Reusable BeforeValidator and AfterValidator types that coerce, constrain and normalize values, tested offline, including the defaults-are-not-validated gotcha.

results.title: peewee JSONField queries on SQLite after SqliteExtDatabase removal
results.summary: Store and query JSON documents with peewee's core JSONField on SqliteDatabase, covering item access, as_text, has_key, contains and in-place mutations, plus the peewee 4 removal of playhouse SqliteExtDatabase.

results.title: jsdiff unified patches: create, apply with fuzz, reverse and word diff
results.summary: Create unified diffs with the diff package, apply them (with fuzz for drifted sources), reverse a patch, count added/removed lines and render word-level diffs.
